subject: Game Theory
title: Rational Irrationality
description: A short lesson to help you apply Rational Irrationality.

hook.text: The dilemma suggests something unsettling: rational individuals can produce irrational outcomes.

buildup.text: Each player maximizes their payoff. Yet the result is worse for everyone than a naive cooperative choice.

discovery.text: Philosophers call this the 'paradox of rationality'—logic fails at the group level.

twist.text: Some argue truly rational agents would cooperate, seeing that mutual defection serves nobody.

climax.text: The debate continues: is defection rational, or does true rationality go beyond self-interest?

quiz.question: What is the 'paradox of rationality'?
options: Rational choices lead to irrational group outcomes
